package.name: sil_pulse_adapter
package.description: M1-M8 heartbeat aggregation (C++). Replaces the pulse portion of sil_topic_bridge.py (Track A A5). Subscribes the 8 L3 module output topics, publishes a sil_msgs/ModulePulse per module @ 1 Hz with GREEN/RED health (10 s timeout). No behavior logic.
